verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark is blown up almost to headline size and placed under the headline. The badges are stretched wider than the CTA and placed below it, so they compete with it. The green circle has moved off the phone into the bottom corner, where it collides with the SUMMER ONLY badge. The SUMMER ONLY badge has shrunk to an unreadable pill on top of a cut-off circle, and there is a large empty gap above the headline.
